PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak/moderate inversion for gm efficiency)
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # input pair L (gain, flicker noise)
    "gmidp": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lp":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),        # PMOS load L (gain, PSRR)
    "itail": (7.5e-6, 5.5e-6, 8.2e-6),  # tail current (power-limited: total <= 18.3uA)
    "gmidt": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # tail mirror gm/Id (headroom)
    "Lt":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # tail mirror L (CMRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    # PMOS mirror load: vds = vsg (diode side), roughly equal on output side at balance
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.9)
    vout_q = vdd - mp.vgs
    # tail node estimate: input pair source
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vout_q - 0.35, 0.2), vsb=0.35)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vout_q - vtail, 0.2), vsb=vtail)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)

    # tail mirror (ratio itail/iref), same L & gm/Id as the reference diode
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], it, vds=vtail)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mr = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mr.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", mp)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + mp.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * mp.cgg + m1.cdd + mp.cdd
    fmir = mp.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # mirror pole-zero doublet (zero at 2*fmir) -> modest phase loss
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * fmir)))
    sr = it / cout
    cmrr = a0 * 2 * mp.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = a0  # 5T with PMOS mirror: vdd -> vout gain ~1
    swing = (vdd - mp.vdsat - 0.05) - (vtail + 0.12)
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = 0.5 / sr + 4.6 * tau
    # thermal noise estimate (flicker set by large gate area)
    st = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2.0 / 3.0) * 2 / gm1 * (1 + mp.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(st) * 4.0   # rough flicker multiplier at 1 kHz
    power = vdd * (iref + it)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": gbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "noise_1k": noise,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "slew": sr,
        "power": power,
        "swing": swing,
        "settle": settle,
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
    }
